findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the backing key material is disabled. Every object encrypted by this audit bucket key remains protected indefinitely by a single key version, so compromise or cryptographic weakening of that version has an unbounded blast radius and cannot be mitigated by retiring older key material.
